node.title: L1 full-pullback divisibility/Johnson closure
node.statement: On an official dyadic row with k>1 and source petal ell=sigma+1, fix a nontrivial dyadic s|n and s|ell whose monic degree-s fibers partition the domain. A fully fiberwise exact support has size divisible by s, while the source threshold a*=k+ell-1 is not; the class starts at h0=ceil(a*/s) quotient agreements. With b=n/s, K0=ceil(k/s), and d=K0-1, a direct pairwise-intersection argument bounds every fixed-map list by floor(b(h0-d)/(h0^2-bd))<=b^2 whenever h0^2>bd. For s<=k this gate is exactly (k+ell)^2>(k-s)n; for s>k it is automatic. Combining with the tame map census pays all tame fixed-source maps in this full-partition fully fiberwise Johnson sector by at most n b^2<=n^3. This theorem alone leaves the full-partition sub-Johnson, partial-fiber, sparse-coverage, wild, unanchored, and arbitrary-locator branches; the later full-domain intrinsic-rigidity theorem routes the first of those to the exact-periodic owner.
